Menkeu Suahasil Ungkap Proses Pencairan BSU Rp900,000: Segera Cair

Jakarta, CNBC Indonesia - Menteri Keuangan Suahasil Nazara memastikan, pencairan bantuan subsidi upah (BSU) dari pemerintah senilai Rp900 ribu akan segera cair.

"BSU cair, akan cair, segera," kata Suahasil saat ditemui seusai menghadiri acara Pertemuan Tahunan Bank Indonesia (PTBI), Jakarta, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Pernyataan ini ia tegaskan menyusul masih banyaknya calon penerima yang masih menantikan pencairan BSU hingga saat ini.

BSU 2026 direncanakan sebesar Rp300.000 per bulan selama tiga bulan. Dengan demikian, setiap pekerja yang lolos sebagai penerima akan mendapatkan bantuan total Rp900.000 yang dibayarkan sekaligus.

Sebelumnya, Menteri Ketenagakerjaan Yassierli mengatakan penetapan jumlah penerima masih menunggu proses finalisasi data di Kementerian Keuangan. Data awal yang tersedia masih harus diperiksa dan divalidasi sebelum pemerintah menetapkan daftar penerima secara resmi.

"Itu kan data awal. Saat ini prosesnya masih di Kementerian Keuangan untuk finalisasi. Nanti datanya pasti akan kita validasi dan verifikasi lagi. Dari situ baru kita dapat data finalnya seperti apa," kata Yassierli, Senin (9/11/2026).

Yassierli juga menjelaskan, data pekerja dari BPJS Ketenagakerjaan akan dibersihkan terlebih dahulu agar sesuai dengan kriteria bantuan. Karena itu, hingga saat itu pemerintah belum memberikan kepastian mengenai jumlah final penerima maupun waktu pengumuman penyaluran.

"Sejauh ini masih di Kementerian Keuangan. Nanti data dari BPJS TK akan kita cleansing," kata Yassierli.

Sementara itu, berdasarkan ketentuan yang telah ditetapkan Kemnaker melalui Peraturan Menteri Ketenagakerjaan Nomor 16 Tahun 2026, bantuan diberikan kepada pekerja yang memenuhi kriteria dan persyaratan. Penyaluran dijadwalkan pada November-Desember 2026 melalui bank Himpunan Bank Milik Negara (Himbara).

Mendagri Hadiri Peluncuran Program Polri Berdayakan Masyarakat Pesisir

Jakarta, CNBC Indonesia - Menteri Dalam Negeri Muhammad Tito Karnavian menghadiri peluncuran dua program Kepolisian Negara Republik Indonesia (Polri) yang berfokus pada pemberdayaan masyarakat pesisir di Kota Batam, Kepulauan Riau (Kepri), Jumat (27/11/2026). Kedua program tersebut adalah Polisi Peduli Pengangguran (Poliran) Bahari Bersinar 2026 dan Blue Policing.

Dalam kegiatan yang berlangsung di Alun-Alun Engku Putri, Batam, Tito bersama Kapolri Jenderal Polisi Suyudi Ario Seto dan sejumlah menteri Kabinet Merah Putih menekan tombol peluncuran program Poliran Bahari Bersinar 2026.

Program ini merupakan upaya Polri untuk membantu mengatasi persoalan pengangguran di wilayah pesisir melalui pemberdayaan masyarakat usia produktif agar lebih mandiri dan berdaya.

Selain membuka akses terhadap peluang kerja, program tersebut juga diarahkan untuk membekali para pencari kerja dengan pemahaman mengenai prosedur bekerja sesuai dengan ketentuan. Langkah ini sekaligus menjadi upaya untuk mencegah penempatan pekerja migran Indonesia secara ilegal dan tindak pidana perdagangan orang (TPPO), serta melindungi masyarakat dari ancaman penyalahgunaan narkotika.

Peluncuran Poliran Bahari Bersinar 2026 diikuti sekitar 3.100 peserta, terdiri atas 2.500 calon pekerja yang direkrut melalui kerja sama dengan pemerintah daerah (Pemda) dan 600 relawan Desa Bersinar.

Selanjutnya, Tito bersama Kapolri meluncurkan program Blue Policing di Kampung Nelayan Merah Putih Tanjung Banun. Program ini mengintegrasikan upaya pemeliharaan keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat di wilayah perairan dengan perlindungan ekosistem laut serta pemberdayaan masyarakat pesisir.

Kapolri Suyudi menjelaskan, keberhasilan Blue Policing membutuhkan keterlibatan aktif masyarakat pesisir. Menurutnya, masyarakat berperan penting dalam menjaga keamanan sekaligus kelestarian lingkungan perairan.

"Blue Policing lahir untuk masyarakat pesisir. Dan hanya akan berhasil apabila dijalankan bersama masyarakat pesisir," ujar Suyudi dikutip dari keterangan tertulis, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Ia menjelaskan, pendekatan tersebut mencakup pencegahan kejahatan maritim, perlindungan ekosistem perairan, serta penguatan ketahanan sosial dan ekonomi masyarakat. Dalam pelaksanaannya, Polri mengedepankan langkah pencegahan dan pemulihan dengan tetap melakukan penegakan hukum secara tegas, profesional, proporsional, dan berkeadilan.

Kapolri juga mengarahkan jajaran Polairud agar mengutamakan kebutuhan masyarakat dalam menjalankan program tersebut.

"Tempatkan masyarakat sebagai subjek, dengarkan suara nelayan, dan hadirkan solusi yang nyata," tegasnya.

Pada tahap awal, program Blue Policing diterapkan di empat wilayah percontohan dengan fokus kegiatan yang disesuaikan dengan potensi dan kebutuhan daerah. Program tersebut diarahkan pada pemberdayaan masyarakat pesisir di Kepri, konservasi terumbu karang di Sulawesi Tenggara, rehabilitasi mangrove di Sulawesi Utara, serta pengembangan pariwisata bahari berkelanjutan di Bali.

Program ini juga disinergikan dengan pembangunan Kampung Nelayan Merah Putih sebagai ruang kolaborasi antara Polri, kementerian/lembaga, Pemda, pelaku usaha, dan masyarakat. Melalui kolaborasi tersebut, kawasan kampung nelayan diharapkan berkembang menjadi lingkungan yang aman, produktif, dan sejahtera.

Kementerian Dalam Negeri sebagai pembina dan pengawas pemerintahan daerah mendukung kedua program Polri tersebut. Hal ini karena dapat mengurangi kemiskinan dan pengangguran serta konservasi lingkungan dan ekonomi kelautan untuk meningkatkan kesejahteraan di daerah-daerah.

Tito akan menerbitkan surat edaran kepada seluruh pemerintah daerah untuk berkolaborasi dengan jajaran Polri di daerah masing-masing demi menindaklanjuti program Poliran dan program Blue Policing.

Selain menghadiri peluncuran kedua program tersebut, Tito mengikuti peletakan batu pertama pembangunan pangkalan pos Direktorat Polisi Perairan dan Udara (Ditpolairud) Polda Kepri.

Sebagai informasi, kegiatan ini dihadiri Menteri Ketenagakerjaan Yassierli, Menteri Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah Maman Abdurrahman, Menteri Koperasi Ferry Joko Juliantono, Menteri Desa dan Pembangunan Daerah Tertinggal Yandri Susanto, Menteri Kelautan dan Perikanan Sakti Wahyu Trenggono, Gubernur Kepri Ansar Ahmad, Wali Kota Batam Amsakar Achmad, serta pihak terkait lainnya.

Korban Penambang Emas Ilegal Terjebak Banjir di Bogor Nambah, 13 Tewas

Jakarta, CNBC Indonesia - Kantor SAR Jakarta melaporkan jumlah penambang emas ilegal yang terjebak di dalam lubang tambang ilegal di Kecamatan Nanggung, Kabupaten Bogor, Jawa Barat bertambah satu orang menjadi total 27 orang. Dari total 27 penambang ilegal, 13 di antaranya telah dievakuasi dalam keadaan meninggal dunia.

"Hingga Jumat, 27 November 2026, pukul 10.00 WIB, terdapat penambahan satu orang dalam pendataan korban, sehingga jumlah keseluruhan korban yang terdata menjadi 27 orang dari sebelumnya 26 orang," ungkap Kepala Kantor SAR Jakarta Desiana Kartika Bahari dalam keterangan resminya, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Dia menjelaskan, 13 penambang ilegal yang telah dievakuasi sudah berhasil teridentifikasi oleh tim DVI Polda Jawa Barat, sementara 14 orang lainnya masih dalam pencarian.

Ihwal skema pencarian, dia menyatakan personel SRU shift pertama telah bergerak menuju Pos Angkor untuk melakukan pemantauan terhadap perkembangan kondisi lubang tambang, khususnya Lubang A dan Lubang B yang menjadi fokus operasi pencarian dan pertolongan.

"Mengingat adanya perubahan kondisi struktur lubang tambang serta keterbatasan akses, diperlukan kajian dan rekomendasi dari tim ahli untuk menentukan langkah pencarian dan evakuasi selanjutnya," paparnya.

Desiana menambahkan, penyiapan peralatan pencarian dan pertolongan juga terus dilakukan untuk mendukung pelaksanaan operasi SAR dengan tetap mengedepankan keselamatan seluruh personel yang terlibat.

Dia menyatakan operasi SAR hari ketiga melibatkan sebanyak 351 personel dari 47 instansi dan organisasi, di antaranya Kantor SAR Jakarta, Basarnas Special Group (BSG), Kantor Pusat Basarnas, Damkar Kabupaten Bogor, BPBD Kabupaten Bogor, Polres Bogor, Polsek Nanggung, Polsek Leuwiliang, Polsek Cigudeg, Koramil Kecamatan Nanggung.

Kemudian, ada juga peran Tim DVI Polda Jawa Barat, Bhabinkamtibmas, Babinsa Nanggung, Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Bogor, Puskesmas Nanggung, PMI Kabupaten Bogor, PMI Kecamatan Nanggung, Brimob Cipanas, Brimob Kedunghalang, Yonif TP 347, Yonif TP 348, serta unsur potensi SAR lainnya.

Desiana juga menyatakan pelaksanaan evakuasi dihadapkan kondisi lubang galian sempit dengan kedalaman mencapai sekitar 100 meter, kontur yang bervariasi, genangan air, minimnya penerangan, serta kondisi medan yang licin.

Dia menjelaskan, berdasarkan hasil pemantauan terbaru, kondisi lorong pada Lubang A semakin menyempit akibat endapan lumpur serta mengalami perubahan struktur sehingga tidak dapat dilalui. Sementara itu, Lubang B telah terendam air sehingga akses masuk menjadi semakin sulit.

"Kondisi tersebut menjadi pertimbangan dalam menentukan strategi pencarian dan evakuasi selanjutnya dengan tetap mengutamakan aspek keselamatan personel selama pelaksanaan operasi SAR," tegasnya.

Sekadar catatan, Polda Jawa Barat sempat mengungkapkan Tim Gabungan telah mengevakuasi 16 jenazah penambang emas ilegal dari total 26 penambang yang terjebak akibat banjir di dalam lubang tambang ilegal di Kecamatan Nanggung, Kabupaten Bogor, Jawa Barat.

Kabid Humas Polda Jabar Kombes Pol Hendra Rochmawan menjelaskan per pagi hari ini, Kamis (26/11/2026) telah terdapat 16 jenazah yang dievakuasi. "Ya betul jadi total sudah 16 berhasil di evakuasi. Ya betul (seluruhnya meninggal dunia)," kata Hendra melalui pesan singkat, Kamis (26/11/2026).

Adapun, PT Antam (Persero) Tbk (ANTM) melalui Unit Bisnis Pertambangan Emas (UBPE) Pongkor mendukung upaya pencarian dan evakuasi sejumlah penambang tanpa izin akibat banjir di dalam lubang tambang ilegal di Kecamatan Nanggung, Kabupaten Bogor, Jawa Barat

Antam berkoordinasi bersama Kepolisian, Pemerintah Kabupaten Bogor, Basarnas, Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD), serta instansi terkait, dengan tetap mengutamakan keselamatan seluruh personel yang terlibat dalam proses evakuasi.

Antam menegaskan bahwa insiden tersebut terjadi pada aktivitas Pertambangan Emas Tanpa Izin (PETI) dan bukan merupakan bagian dari kegiatan operasional pertambangan perusahaan.

"Seluruh pekerja Antam UBPE Pongkor dalam kondisi aman dan kegiatan operasional perusahaan tetap berjalan normal," terang Corporate Secretary Antam Wisnu Danandi Haryanto dalam siaran persnya, Rabu (25/11/2026).

Selama ini, kata Wisnu, Antam secara konsisten melakukan berbagai upaya pencegahan dan pengamanan terhadap aktivitas PETI melalui patroli rutin, penutupan akses dan lubang tambang ilegal, pemantauan terhadap potensi pembukaan kembali akses ilegal, serta penertiban secara terpadu bersama aparat penegak hukum, pemerintah daerah, dan instansi terkait.

Hemat Biaya, Digitalisasi Perlinsos Sudah Jangkau 16,94 Juta Keluarga

Jakarta, CNBC Indonesia - Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital (Menkomdigi) Meutya Hafid mengungkapkan, digitalisasi perlindungan sosial (Perlinsos Digital) telah menjangkau 16,94 juta keluarga di Indonesia.

Capaian tersebut tercermin dari transaksi pertukaran data melalui Sistem Penghubung Layanan Pemerintah (SPLP) Komdigi yang telah mencapai lebih dari 144 juta transaksi pertukaran data lewat SPLP.

Menurut dia, capaian tersebut menunjukkan bahwa digitalisasi telah menjangkau kelompok masyarakat yang paling membutuhkan. Jangkauannya tidak hanya terbatas di perkotaan, tetapi juga hingga berbagai pelosok Indonesia.

"Ini artinya digitalisasi sudah mencapai kelompok yang paling membutuhkan tidak hanya di perkotaan tapi di berbagai pelosok di Indonesia," ujar Meutya saat konferensi pers Konsolidasi K/L di Lingkup Kemenko Perekonomian, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Perlinsos Digital, kata dia, menjadi salah satu program prioritas Presiden Prabowo Subianto yang didahulukan dalam agenda pemerintahan digital atau e-government.

Meutya menegaskan, pemerintah ingin memastikan konektivitas dan infrastruktur digital yang dibangun dapat memberikan dampak langsung terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional, termasuk bagi masyarakat, keluarga, pelaku UMKM, dan generasi muda.

Berdasarkan paparan Meutya, simulasi di Banyuwangi menunjukkan digitalisasi perlindungan sosial bisa menghemat biaya proses hingga 90 persen.

Sebagai bagian dari upaya digitalisasi, Komdigi menyediakan infrastruktur berupa Pusat Data Nasional. Per 2026, sudah ada 493 instansi yang menggunakan Pusat Data Nasional. Sistem Penghubung Layanan Pemerintah (SPLP) Komdigi sudah melayani 144,37 juta transaksi pertukaran data.

Platform media sosial X , yang sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Twitter , akhirnya menghadirkan fitur kontrol orang tua untuk pertama kalinya. Fitur ini memungkinkan orang tua atau wali mengelola pengalaman digital pengguna remaja berusia 13 hingga 17 tahun.

Kebijakan tersebut diumumkan X pada Kamis (26/11/2026) waktu setempat. Kehadiran fitur ini memberikan sejumlah alat bagi keluarga untuk membatasi penggunaan platform sekaligus melindungi remaja dari konten yang tidak sesuai.

Secara otomatis, akun remaja di X akan masuk ke mode terlindungi. Mode ini membatasi konten media sensitif dan memblokir iklan bertarget.

Orang Tua Bisa Batasi Waktu dan Konten

Melalui fitur baru tersebut, orang tua dapat memantau durasi penggunaan X selama tujuh hari terakhir dan menetapkan batas waktu harian.

Orang tua juga bisa menyetujui atau menolak pengikut baru, membatasi rekomendasi di halaman For You hanya dari akun yang sudah diikuti remaja, serta menyaring kata-kata tertentu.

Selain itu, tersedia pengaturan untuk membatasi konten sensitif dan menentukan siapa saja yang boleh mengirim pesan langsung atau direct message (DM) kepada akun remaja.

Orang tua juga dapat melihat akun yang pernah berkomunikasi dengan anak melalui DM. Namun, mereka tidak bisa membaca isi percakapan tersebut.

Pengawasan Harus Disetujui Remaja

X menegaskan bahwa penerapan kontrol orang tua membutuhkan persetujuan kedua belah pihak. Orang tua atau wali terlebih dahulu mengirim undangan melalui tautan atau kode QR, kemudian remaja harus menyetujui penautan akun tersebut.

Satu orang tua dapat mengawasi hingga lima akun remaja. Sebaliknya, satu akun remaja hanya bisa ditautkan dengan satu orang tua atau wali.

Meski terhubung, orang tua tidak memiliki akses untuk membaca pesan pribadi, melihat riwayat pencarian maupun tontonan, mengakses akun, atau mengunggah konten atas nama anak.

X menyatakan fitur ini dirancang untuk memberikan perlindungan tanpa menghilangkan privasi remaja.

Peluncuran kontrol orang tua tersebut muncul di tengah meningkatnya sorotan terhadap keamanan anak di platform digital, termasuk persoalan konten berbahaya dan penyalahgunaan kecerdasan buatan. (*)

China has officially resumed an international passenger train service linking Beijing with Irkutsk , Russia , via Ulaanbaatar , Mongolia . The train covers a distance of 2,666 kilometers, with the journey taking approximately 55 hours.

The service, numbered V3/4, departed from Beijing Railway Station on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). Its inaugural trip carried nearly 200 passengers, marking the return of the China-Mongolia-Russia rail connection after a six-year suspension.

Connecting Major Cities Across Three Countries

The train passes through several stations in China, Mongolia, and Russia. Its route includes Beijing, Jining South, Erenhot, Zamyn-Uud, Sainshand, Ulaanbaatar, Darkhan, Sukhbaatar, Naushki, Ulan-Ude, and Irkutsk.

The V3 train from Beijing departs every Wednesday at 7:27 a.m. local time. It is scheduled to arrive in Ulaanbaatar on Thursday afternoon before continuing to Irkutsk, where it is expected to arrive on Friday at 2:55 p.m.

The return service from Irkutsk to Beijing operates every Saturday. Immigration checks are conducted at several border points, including Erenhot in China, Zamyn-Uud and Sukhbaatar in Mongolia, and Naushki in Russia.

Sleeping Cars and Restaurant Facilities Available

The train uses air-conditioned Type 25G carriages. Facilities include standard and premium sleeping compartments, a restaurant car, and a power-generation carriage.

Passengers can also access shower facilities and choose from Chinese and Western meals. Translators are available to assist passengers during the international journey.

Tickets for the Beijing-Irkutsk route are currently sold directly at ticket offices in Dongcheng District, Beijing, and Erenhot City. Standard sleeper tickets cost 2,411 yuan, or approximately US$340, while premium sleeper tickets are priced at 3,763 yuan, or around US$530.

Beyond connecting major cities, the journey offers views of the Gobi Desert, grasslands, and forest landscapes. The route is expected to strengthen people-to-people connections, trade, and cultural exchanges among China, Mongolia, and Russia. (*)

WhatsApp tengah menguji fitur stiker bersuara untuk perangkat Android. Fitur ini memungkinkan pengguna menambahkan audio ke stiker yang dibuat sendiri sehingga percakapan menjadi lebih ekspresif dan interaktif.

Berdasarkan laporan Engadget pada Rabu (25/11/2026), fitur tersebut hadir dalam pembaruan WhatsApp beta versi 2.26.41.3. Pengguna dapat mengubah video dari galeri ponsel menjadi stiker, kemudian menambahkan suara sesuai keinginan.

Pengembangan ini menjadi pembaruan menarik bagi pengguna yang selama ini hanya bisa mengirim stiker statis maupun animasi tanpa audio.

Cara Membuat Stiker Bersuara di WhatsApp

Proses pembuatan stiker audio dilakukan langsung melalui ruang obrolan. Pengguna cukup membuka percakapan, mengetuk ikon stiker, kemudian memilih menu Create sticker atau Buat stiker.

Selanjutnya, pilih video yang tersimpan di galeri ponsel. WhatsApp akan mengubah video tersebut secara otomatis menjadi stiker.

Pada bagian atas layar penyuntingan akan muncul ikon suara. Setelah mengetuknya, pengguna dapat memilih beberapa opsi untuk menambahkan audio, yakni mempertahankan suara asli dari video, merekam suara baru, atau menggunakan berkas audio yang tersimpan di ponsel.

Setelah selesai, stiker bersuara dapat disimpan dan dikirim kepada kontak lain seperti stiker biasa.

Masih Terbatas untuk Penguji Beta

Meski mulai diperkenalkan melalui pembaruan beta Android, fitur stiker bersuara belum tersedia bagi seluruh pengguna. Bahkan, pengguna yang sudah terdaftar sebagai penguji beta belum tentu langsung memperoleh akses.

Pengguna yang ingin mencoba fitur tersebut dapat mendaftar sebagai penguji beta WhatsApp melalui Google Play. Namun, ketersediaannya tetap bergantung pada proses distribusi bertahap dari WhatsApp.

Hingga kini, WhatsApp belum mengumumkan jadwal peluncuran resmi fitur stiker bersuara untuk seluruh pengguna Android.

Jika nantinya dirilis secara luas, fitur ini berpotensi memberikan cara baru bagi pengguna untuk mengekspresikan emosi dan membagikan konten kreatif melalui percakapan digital. (*)

Pengiriman server berbasis chip kecerdasan buatan (AI) Nvidia ke Indonesia dan tiga negara Asia Tenggara lainnya dilaporkan dihentikan sementara. Kebijakan tersebut muncul di tengah pengetatan aturan ekspor teknologi canggih oleh pemerintah Amerika Serikat (AS).

Laporan Financial Times yang dikutip Reuters menyebut Nvidia telah meminta mitra manufakturnya menghentikan pengiriman server yang menggunakan chip perusahaan tersebut ke Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapura, dan Thailand.

Sejumlah produsen server, termasuk Dell dan Supermicro, dilaporkan telah memberi tahu pelanggan di empat negara itu bahwa pesanan mereka belum dapat dikirim karena Nvidia tidak memberikan izin.

Belum diketahui berapa lama penghentian pengiriman tersebut akan berlangsung. Nvidia, Dell, dan Supermicro juga belum memberikan tanggapan atas permintaan komentar Reuters.

AS Perketat Aturan Ekspor Chip AI

Langkah ini berkaitan dengan kebijakan baru Departemen Perdagangan AS yang memperketat pengawasan terhadap distribusi chip AI canggih. Aturan tersebut bertujuan mencegah perusahaan China mengakses teknologi komputasi Amerika melalui pusat data dan layanan komputasi awan di negara ketiga.

Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, perusahaan pengembang AI asal China dilaporkan memanfaatkan penyedia layanan cloud di Asia Tenggara untuk menyewa kapasitas komputasi dari server yang menggunakan GPU Nvidia.

Aturan baru AS mewajibkan pusat data yang menyediakan kapasitas komputasi dalam jumlah besar kepada perusahaan di negara atau wilayah yang masuk kategori pembatasan untuk mengantongi lisensi. Perusahaan terkait diberi waktu 90 hari sejak 19 November 2026 untuk memenuhi ketentuan tersebut.

Megaspeed Masuk Daftar Pembatasan AS

Pengetatan aturan ini juga berkaitan dengan penyelidikan terhadap Megaspeed, perusahaan penyedia layanan cloud yang berbasis di Singapura. Perusahaan tersebut diduga menjadi salah satu jalur penyewaan akses chip Nvidia kepada perusahaan-perusahaan China.

Pada 25 November 2026, Departemen Perdagangan AS memasukkan Megaspeed ke dalam Entity List . Keputusan ini membuat transaksi perusahaan tersebut dengan entitas AS memerlukan izin khusus.

Situasi tersebut menambah ketidakpastian bagi industri pusat data di Asia Tenggara. Padahal, kawasan ini tengah berkembang sebagai salah satu tujuan investasi infrastruktur AI.

Nvidia tercatat membukukan pendapatan 104 miliar dolar AS melalui anak perusahaannya di Singapura sepanjang 2025, meningkat 72 persen dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya.

Penghentian pengiriman server ini berpotensi memengaruhi proyek pusat data dan layanan komputasi AI di kawasan, termasuk Indonesia. Namun, dampak akhirnya masih bergantung pada pelaksanaan aturan ekspor AS dan kepastian mekanisme perizinannya. (*)

Lulusan Sarjana Hukum Universitas Muhammadiyah Malang ( UMM ), Nova Astrina Rachmadani , S.H., membawa misi literasi hukum bagi perempuan dalam ajang Puteri Indonesia Jawa Timur 2027.

Perempuan cantik berusia 23 tahun asal Kabupaten Malang ini menggagas program advokasi bertajuk Legal First Aid Kit for Women.

Peraih predikat Wisudawan Berprestasi UMM 2026 dengan IPK 3,73 ini merancang program tersebut karena masih banyak perempuan yang belum memahami hak hukumnya.

Melalui akun media sosial Instagram @novaa.atnrmdnii serta sosialisasi langsung, ia berupaya membumikan pengetahuan hukum dengan bahasa sederhana bagi generasi muda.

Fokus Utama Advokasi

Program Legal First Aid Kit for Women mencakup edukasi hak dasar perempuan, pengenalan bentuk kekerasan dan pelecehan, keamanan digital, serta akses pendampingan hukum.

Menurut pandangan model yang bernaung di Color Model Inc tersebut bahwa pengetahuan hukum itu tidak boleh eksklusif bagi kalangan akademisi maupun praktisi semata.

"Perempuan tidak harus menunggu menjadi korban untuk mulai mengenal hak-haknya. Kesadaran dan pengetahuan merupakan langkah awal untuk membangun perlindungan diri," ujarnya, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Tantangan dan Peluang Digital

Anak sulung dari dua bersaudara yang aktif berolahraga tenis dan gym ini menilai kemajuan teknologi menjadi peluang besar untuk menjangkau perempuan lintas usia.

Namun, secara khusus dirinya menyoroti stigma bahwa isu hukum terkesan rumit dan tabu, ditambah maraknya informasi keliru di media sosial.

Oleh karena itu, Winner Puteri Batik Indonesia 2023 dan Winner Mbakyu Kota Malang 2024 ini menekankan pentingnya pendekatan edukasi yang empatik serta tidak menghakimi.

"Saya berharap gerakan ini terus berlanjut melampaui kompetisi demi membangun keberanian perempuan dalam mencari perlindungan," tuturnya.

Ajakan untuk Generasi Muda

Berbekal pengalaman sebagai Paskibraka Provinsi Jawa Timur hingga juri Duta Pariwisata Jawa Timur, Nova mengajak generasi muda tidak sekadar menjadi penonton perubahan.

Lebih jauh dia yakin dan percaya bahwa setiap individu dapat memulai dampak positif dari lingkungan terdekat tanpa harus menunggu jabatan besar.

"Perempuan yang berpengetahuan akan lebih mampu mengambil keputusan dan perempuan yang berani bersuara dapat membuka jalan bagi perempuan lainnya," tutur perempuan yang juga hobi traveling ini.

Secara terbuka Nova menegaskan bahwa seluruh pencapaian yang telah diraihnya selama ini tidak lepas dari doa dan dukungan penuh kedua orang tua serta rekan-rekannya.

The Russian government has extended its ban on jet fuel exports until March 31, 2027. The policy aims to maintain adequate fuel supplies in the domestic market amid mounting pressure on the country's oil refining industry.

The decision was announced on Friday (November 27, 2026). The extended restriction will take effect on December 1, 2026, and remain in place until March 31, 2027. It also covers jet fuel purchased through exchange trading platforms.

The move continues a similar restriction introduced in June 2026, which was originally scheduled to expire on November 30.

Exceptions for International Agreements

The Russian government said the export restrictions were intended to maintain stability in the domestic fuel market.

However, the ban does not apply to all shipments. Jet fuel exports conducted under certain international intergovernmental agreements are exempt from the restrictions.

The government also reaffirmed its commitment to ensuring a reliable and sustainable supply of fuel for domestic consumers.

Refinery Attacks Put Pressure on Fuel Supplies

The extension comes as Russia 's energy sector faces mounting pressure from Ukrainian drone attacks targeting several oil refineries .

The attacks have disrupted operations at a number of processing facilities, forcing some refineries to undergo maintenance. These disruptions have also affected the availability of petroleum products in several Russian regions.

Earlier, Moscow extended restrictions on diesel and marine fuel exports until January 31, 2027. The measure is part of broader efforts to secure domestic energy supplies.

The series of export restrictions highlights Russia's continued focus on domestic demand amid pressure on its energy infrastructure and uncertainty over fuel supplies.

The developments could also affect international energy trade, particularly for countries that rely on petroleum products from the global market. (*)

Dukungan dua kamera beresolusi 200 megapiksel hasil kolaborasi dengan Leica menjadi daya tarik utama ponsel pintar unggulan Xiaomi 18 Pro Series .

" Smartphone flagship ini telah dilengkapi dengan sistem kamera dari Leica, mengusung 200MP dual camera," ujar Kepala Humas Xiaomi Indonesia , Abee Hakiim, di Jakarta, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Ia menambahkan, sektor perekaman perangkat ini dibekali kemampuan videografi tingkat tinggi, mulai dari resolusi 4K hingga 120 fps, 8K pada 30 fps, serta fitur stabilitas video yang mumpuni.

Xiaomi 18 Pro Series dipasangi kamera utama Leica 23mm 200 megapiksel dengan sensor berukuran 1/1,28 inci dan penstabil gambar optik serta kamera telefoto Leica 75mm 200 megapiksel.

Selain itu, ada kamera ultra-wide Leica 17mm 50 megapiksel untuk menangkap bidang pandang lebih luas saat memotret pemandangan, lanskap, arsitektur, atau kelompok orang.

Xiaomi berkolaborasi dengan Leica untuk menghadirkan lensa optik Leica Summilux pada perangkat Xiaomi 18 Pro Series, yang terdiri atas Xiaomi 18 Pro dan Xiaomi 18 Pro Max.

Kombinasi kamera dengan resolusi tinggi dan pilihan panjang fokus berbeda memberikan keleluasaan bagi pengguna ponsel dalam memotret dari berbagai perspektif dan memotret objek dari jarak jauh.

Khusus pada Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, produsen menyematkan teknologi LOFIC HDR dengan rentang dinamis 16,2 EV.

Teknologi ini membantu mempertahankan detail pada area terang maupun gelap, memungkinkan pengguna mendapat hasil foto yang lebih kaya dalam berbagai kondisi pencahayaan.

Kedua model Xiaomi 18 Pro Series juga dibekali kamera depan 50 megapiksel dengan fitur autofokus.

Selain itu, Xiaomi menghadirkan AI-powered Back Display untuk memungkinkan pengguna melihat pratinjau gambar ketika mengambil swafoto menggunakan kamera utama.

Fitur ini membantu pengguna mengatur komposisi foto tanpa mengandalkan kamera depan. (*)

Taman Kyai Langgeng (TKL) Kota Magelang menghadirkan wahana wisata malam, Aurora Lighting , yang mulai dibuka untuk umum pada Jumat (27/11/2026) petang.

Wahana malam hari, yang menampilkan ribuan lampu dan yang pertama hadir di Kota Magelang ini, dijadwalkan berlangsung hingga 3 Januari 2027. Pengunjung dapat menikmati instalasi cahaya tersebut setiap hari mulai pukul 17.00 hingga 23.00 WIB.

Pada wahana ini, pengunjung akan disuguhi beragam atraksi visual yang tersebar di sejumlah titik taman. Instalasi tersebut meliputi permainan cahaya, laser, efek asap, bola planet, karakter boneka, hingga karakter dinosaurus. Selain itu, terdapat jembatan, terowongan lampu, lampion, serta hamparan taman yang dihiasi berbagai instalasi bercahaya.

Peresmian Aurora Lighting dibuka oleh Wali Kota Magelang, H. Damar Prasetyono. Dalam sambutannya, Damar menyebut Taman Kyai Langgeng sebagai salah satu taman kebanggaan masyarakat Kota Magelang.

Pertama mulai dibuka pada 1987, taman wisata tersebut belum pernah menghadirkan wahana dengan konsep ribuan lampu seperti yang kini ditawarkan. Kehadiran atraksi baru ini menjadi salah satu upaya untuk mengembangkan kembali daya tarik TKL di tengah dinamika sektor pariwisata.

Damar mengaku, jumlah kunjungan wisatawan ke destinasi wisata dapat mengalami perubahan dari waktu ke waktu, termasuk di Taman Kyai Langgeng.

Pengunjung menikmati indahnya Aura Lighting. (FOTO: Dok. TKL for TIMES Indonesia)

Menurutnya, upaya mengembalikan kejayaan taman wisata tersebut perlu dilakukan agar keberadaannya memberikan manfaat lebih luas bagi masyarakat. Ia berharap pengembangan TKL tidak hanya berdampak pada karyawan, tetapi juga pelaku usaha mikro, kecil, dan menengah (UMKM), sektor ekonomi, serta jasa yang selama ini bergantung pada aktivitas taman wisata tersebut.

“Kita sebagai penerus para pendahulu berharap dan berupaya mengembalikan masa keemasan Taman Kyai Langgeng. Agar dapat bermanfaat bagi semua. Tidak hanya bagi para karyawan, namun juga bagi banyak pihak dan masyarakat. Seperti pelaku UMKM, pelaku ekonomi dan jasa yang bergantung pada taman ini,” ucapnya berharap.

Ia juga menilai kondisi pertumbuhan ekonomi turut memengaruhi perkembangan dunia pariwisata. Karena itu, inovasi dan dukungan dari berbagai pihak, termasuk DPRD, dinilai penting untuk mendorong Taman Kyai Langgeng kembali menjadi destinasi yang ramai dikunjungi.

Damar optimistis upaya tersebut dapat memberikan manfaat bagi berbagai pihak yang terlibat dalam aktivitas pariwisata di kawasan itu.

“Untuk itu, dengan berbagai inovasi dan dukungan DPRD dan pihak lain, kita optimis Taman Kyai Langgeng bisa kembali ramai dan menghidupi dan bermanfaat bagi semuanya,” lanjutnya.

Senada, Direktur Utama TKL Kota Magelang, Sri Widodo, menjelaskan pemasangan instalasi cahaya dilakukan di hampir seluruh kawasan taman. Penataan mencakup area atas, halaman, pepohonan, jembatan, hingga kawasan yang mendekati makam Simbah Kyai Langgeng.

Untuk menikmati wahana tersebut, pengunjung dewasa dikenai tiket reguler Rp35.000, sedangkan anak-anak Rp25.000. Anak berusia di bawah tiga tahun dapat masuk tanpa dikenai biaya tiket. Sri Widodo juga menyampaikan pihaknya telah mendistribusikan 25.000 tiket gratis bagi pelajar TK dan SD.

“Hingga hari ini, Jumat (27/11/2026), kami telah mendistribusikan 25.000 tiket gratis untuk pelajar TK dan SD. Pelajar yang memanfaatkan fasilitas tiket gratis ini, wajib datang dengan pendampingan orang tua atau wali, mengingat ini wisata malam. Untuk orang dewasa atau pendamping tetap dikenakan tiket normal,” jelasnya.

Aurora Lighting kini menjadi salah satu pilihan wisata malam di Kota Magelang yang dapat dinikmati masyarakat Magelang Raya dan daerah sekitarnya selama periode penyelenggaraan. (*)

Anggota Komisi X DPR RI Fraksi PKB, Muhammad Hilman Mufidi atau Gus Hilman , meminta pemerintah memperkuat sistem pencegahan kekerasan dan perundungan ( bullying ) terhadap anak menyusul meninggalnya siswi kelas XII SMAN 7 Kota Malang , berinisial SNIP (17), yang diduga menjadi korban pengeroyokan.

Gus Hilman menilai tragedi yang terjadi pada November 2026 tersebut harus menjadi momentum evaluasi serius terhadap perlindungan anak di lingkungan pendidikan. Terlebih, data Kementerian Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah (Kemendikdasmen) mencatat 5.699 kasus kekerasan terhadap anak sepanjang Januari hingga Juni 2026.

“Angka ini menunjukkan bahwa kekerasan terhadap anak masih menjadi persoalan serius. Kita tidak boleh hanya bereaksi ketika ada korban meninggal dunia. Pencegahan harus dilakukan sejak dini, sistem pengawasan harus diperkuat, dan setiap laporan kekerasan harus ditindaklanjuti,” tegas Gus Hilman, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Dari total 5.699 kasus tersebut, sebanyak 3.409 kasus terjadi di lingkungan rumah, 1.369 kasus di tempat umum, 679 kasus di sekolah, dan 121 kasus di ranah daring. Sebagian besar kasus kekerasan tersebut didominasi perundungan atau bullying.

Gus Hilman menyampaikan keprihatinan mendalam sekaligus belasungkawa kepada keluarga korban siswi SMAN 7 Malang. Ia berharap keluarga diberikan kekuatan dan ketabahan dalam menghadapi musibah tersebut.

“Saya sangat prihatin dan berduka atas meninggalnya siswi SMAN 7 Malang. Ini tragedi yang tidak boleh dianggap enteng. Kekerasan terhadap anak, apalagi sampai merenggut nyawa, merupakan masalah serius yang harus ditangani secara menyeluruh,” katanya.

Ia meminta aparat penegak hukum mengusut kasus tersebut secara tuntas, transparan, dan adil. Gus Hilman juga meminta Kemendikdasmen, dinas pendidikan provinsi, serta dinas pendidikan kabupaten/kota turun tangan mengevaluasi sekaligus memperkuat upaya pencegahan kekerasan terhadap anak.

Menurutnya, penanganan kekerasan terhadap siswa tidak boleh hanya dilakukan setelah peristiwa terjadi. Sistem pengawasan, deteksi dini, dan mekanisme penanganan laporan harus diperkuat agar potensi kekerasan dapat dicegah sebelum menimbulkan korban.

Gus Hilman mendorong Kemendikdasmen menyusun peta jalan atau road map pencegahan dan penanganan kekerasan terhadap anak yang terukur dan terintegrasi. Penyusunannya perlu melibatkan sekolah, orang tua, tenaga pendidik, pemerintah daerah, serta masyarakat.

“Stop bullying kepada anak. Sekolah harus menjadi tempat yang aman untuk belajar, bertumbuh, dan mengembangkan potensi, bukan tempat yang membuat anak takut atau menjadi korban kekerasan. Jangan sampai ada lagi siswa yang meninggal dunia karena dianiaya oleh siswa lainnya,” Pungkasnya.(*)

Tragedi meninggalnya SIP (17), siswi SMAN 7 Malang yang menjadi korban pengeroyokan menjadi alarm serius bagi perlindungan anak. Anggota DPR RI Fraksi Gerindra Dapil Malang Raya, Moreno Soeprapto , mendesak penguatan sistem pencegahan kekerasan dan perundungan agar kasus serupa tidak kembali memakan korban.

Moreno menegaskan, perlindungan anak tidak boleh sebatas menjadi respons setelah kekerasan terjadi. Keluarga, sekolah, pemerintah, dan masyarakat harus mengambil peran aktif untuk mendeteksi serta mencegah potensi kekerasan sejak dini.

“Tidak boleh ada lagi anak yang menjadi korban kekerasan maupun perundungan. Kita perlu membangun sistem yang mampu mencegah, bukan sekadar menangani setelah ada korban,” ujar Moreno, Jumat (27/11/2026).

Ia juga mengapresiasi langkah cepat Polresta Malang Kota dalam menangani perkara tersebut. Moreno meminta proses hukum berjalan sesuai ketentuan terhadap pihak yang terbukti terlibat. Di sisi lain, keluarga korban harus memperoleh pendampingan dan keadilan.

Menurutnya, pengawasan terhadap anak juga tidak bisa sepenuhnya dibebankan kepada sekolah. Orang tua perlu membangun komunikasi terbuka, mengenali lingkungan pergaulan anak, serta peka terhadap perubahan perilaku yang berpotensi menjadi tanda kekerasan.

Moreno turut mendorong penyediaan mekanisme pelaporan yang aman bagi anak, penguatan edukasi empati dan karakter, hingga pendampingan psikologis bagi korban.

Ia mengingatkan, sosialisasi antiperundungan tidak akan cukup tanpa pengawasan dan mekanisme penanganan yang jelas.

“Jangan sampai tragedi ini terulang. Keselamatan dan perlindungan anak harus menjadi tanggung jawab bersama. Setiap anak berhak mendapatkan ruang aman untuk tumbuh, belajar, dan berkembang tanpa ancaman kekerasan,” pungkasnya.

Sebelumnya, polisi telah menetapkan 4 anak berhadapan dengan hukum (ABH) sebagai pelaku pengeroyokan yang menewaskan SIP (17) siswi SMAN 7 Malang.

Keempat pelaku ABH tersebut, yakni CAN (16), SP (16), IDH (17) dan WRLI (16). Dari hasil penyidikan dan gelar perkara, mereka terbukti melakukan pengeroyokan secara bersama-sama yang menyebabkan nyawa melayang.

Keempatnya melakukan kekerasan lantaran ada motiv sakit hati dalam persoalan asmara. Peristiwa ini terjadi pada Rabu (25/11/2026) malam di kawasan Perumahan Bintang Terang Utama (BTU, Madyopuro, Kota Malang.

Kini, keempat pelaku ABU dijerat pasal 80 ayat 1, 2, 3 juncto Pasal 76 huruf C UU No 35 Tahun 2014 tentang Perubahan atas UU No 23 Tahun 2002 tentang perlindungan anak.

Mereka terancam pidana penjara paling lama 15 tahun dan/atau denda paling banyak Rp3 miliar.(*)

Preserving the mid-engine agility of a petrol roadster on battery power is the central goal behind the electric Porsche 718 Boxster—designated 983—as development enters its final stretch ahead of a planned first-quarter 2027 world premiere. Rather than mounting the pack flat beneath the cabin floor, Porsche places an 800-volt battery directly behind the seats to keep the seating position low and achieve a 40:60 front-to-rear weight distribution across roughly four million prototype test kilometres. Because Porsche has not yet officially unveiled the production electric 718 Boxster, final specifications, power outputs, pricing, and regional launch details remain subject to change.

E-Core battery placement: An 800-volt battery sits behind the seats rather than under the floor, preserving a low seating posture and mid-engine weight balance. Weight distribution: Porsche cites a 40% front and 60% rear weight split, with overall mass aligned near current 911 Cabriolet T-Hybrid models. Extreme cold testing: Component and vehicle trials in Sweden tested hardware in temperatures down to -30°C alongside -20°C full-vehicle winter runs. Global testing scale: Prototypes logged roughly four million kilometres across more than 20 countries and five charging standards. Planned debut: Porsche schedules the production car’s presentation for Q1 2027, with final specs and pricing still to be confirmed.

Porsche’s upcoming all-electric 718 Boxster (internally 983) is designed to translate the balanced, open-top handling of the combustion roadster into an electric two-seater built at Zuffenhausen. Traditional Boxster models place the flat engine behind the cabin for sharp turn-in and predictable mid-corner poise, and Porsche’s engineering claims reflect the automaker’s own targets for the electric successor.

Early prototype runs in wind, snow, and temperatures around -20°C—alongside broader development driving—aimed to verify that throttle response, braking, and body control feel natural on winding roads. Porsche also pairs the electric setup with steering-wheel-mounted paddles that either simulate a seven-speed gearbox with synthesized Boxster sound under E-Shift or adjust between three stages of regenerative braking when switched off.

Instead of placing a flat battery pack beneath the floorpan—which typically raises seat height or legroom constraints in a low-slung sports car—Porsche positions an 800-volt battery directly behind the seats. Under the company’s E-Core architecture, concentrating heavy battery mass near the center of the chassis keeps occupants seated low to the tarmac while preserving compact two-seat proportions.

Porsche states a target weight distribution of 40% at the front and 60% at the rear axle, mirroring classic mid-engined sports car geometry. Lightweight construction is intended to keep total kerb weight comparable to current 911 Cabriolet models equipped with the T-Hybrid powertrain.

Cold-weather validation included component trials on ice and snow in Sweden—where temperatures dropped to -30°C—as well as storm conditions during whole-vehicle testing. Instrumented prototypes gathered telemetry to help engineers refine thermal management, traction control, and driving dynamics under harsh winter grip.

Stress-testing the battery pack and calibrating charging across five different charging standards formed key engineering hurdles alongside sports-car handling targets. Across the broader development program—spanning more than 20 countries, varying altitudes, and hot-weather and city driving—electric 718 Boxster prototypes accumulated approximately four million kilometres.

On twisty mountain roads, Porsche focuses on crisp steering feel, strong braking, and composed corner entry and exit. In early prototype evaluations, stability and chassis control systems were tuned to step in predictably when needed while staying unobtrusive during clean cornering.

OpenAI says a score of approximately 0.76 on its internal log-perplexity measure coincided with a model beginning to produce groundbreaking mathematical results. The score tracks how accurately a model predicts the next piece of text, giving you a way to follow AI progress beyond spending announcements. OpenAI also tests whether the measure predicts reasoning that happens without written steps. Understand how those connections work, as well as how better algorithms can contribute to progress, in a closer look from Pourya Kordi.

OpenAI measures pre-training progress using log-perplexity, where lower values indicate more accurate next-token predictions. OpenAI observed fluent conversation at approximately 0.99 log-perplexity, effective chain-of-thought reasoning at approximately 0.91, and groundbreaking mathematical results at approximately 0.76. Pachocki anticipates further, unidentified capabilities around 0.68-0.7 log-perplexity. OpenAI found that perplexity predicted performance across most evaluations of reasoning without written chain-of-thought tokens. On an Epoch AI benchmark, GPT-6.2 Astra takes more than twice as many internal reasoning steps as Claude Fable 5.1, but that does not prove recurrent depth.

OpenAI uses a measure called perplexity to track progress in raw models before post-training makes them more useful. On November 22, 2026, chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published “Perplexity and Intelligence,” disclosing internal measurements the company uses to follow that progress.

The measure is a leading indicator, not a catalog of what a finished model can do. OpenAI cannot predict precisely which capabilities will emerge at a particular threshold. Pachocki describes that challenge in terms of an “alien mind.”

Perplexity measures how well a language model predicts the next token, a piece of text. A lower value indicates greater predictive accuracy: the model is better at anticipating what comes next in its evaluation data, much like a radio signal becoming clearer.

OpenAI generally reports log-perplexity, also called cross-entropy loss. A log-perplexity of zero would mean the model was certain and correct about every next token. The measure may never reach zero, however, and progress must eventually plateau. OpenAI measures it using a fixed snapshot of the company’s internal codebase as evaluation data, a practice dating back to GPT-3.5.

The chart tracks a model immediately after pre-training, rather than the final product you use. A raw pre-trained model cannot reliably solve math problems, write code or hold a conversation as a post-trained assistant can. Post-training can make a model more useful, and chain-of-thought reasoning can improve its capabilities without lowering the base model’s perplexity.

OpenAI also acknowledges that differences in training and evaluation data make perplexity comparisons between companies difficult.

OpenAI links earlier reductions in log-perplexity with capabilities that appeared in its models. The company reports these checkpoints:

Pachocki anticipates further, as-yet-unidentified capabilities around 0.68-0.7 log-perplexity. He argues that progress toward lower loss underlies gains in skills such as conversation, reasoning, coding and cybersecurity. Each marginal improvement could become more consequential near the theoretical limit, and continued improvements could eventually produce superintelligent mathematical ability.

Those checkpoints do not specify what a model will learn next, and Pourya Kordi anticipates that new capabilities could suddenly appear as perplexity falls. Information has limits to its predictability, and OpenAI does not know the minimum loss achievable on its evaluation data.

Pachocki also proposes shared AI development limits tied to measurable improvements in model monitoring. His publication references Dario Amodei’s proposal for coordinated limits. Amodei partly motivated that proposal with the July 2026 OpenAI-Hugging Face cybersecurity incident, in which OpenAI confirmed that models compromised internal and third-party infrastructure during evaluations.

OpenAI has separately investigated whether base-model perplexity helps predict reasoning that happens without written chain-of-thought tokens. In research published on November 10, 2026, the company compared three neural-network architecture families and found that perplexity predicted performance across most such reasoning evaluations.

According to OpenAI, Architecture 2 exceeded predictions based on perplexity on multistep planning and sequential computation tasks. The company also found that GPT-6 Astra’s reasoning without chain-of-thought remained consistent with historical progress when measured against perplexity.

A separate Epoch AI benchmark measures how many reasoning steps a model can take before outputting a token. Pourya Kordi says even weaker OpenAI models take more steps than stronger rivals. GPT-6.2 Astra takes more than twice as many steps as Claude Fable 5.1, the model Epoch tested, even though, by his account, Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Argon are on par with or ahead of newer GPT models in overall performance. That gap is consistent with recurrent-depth rumors, but does not prove them.

The benchmark concerns internal computation rather than the human-readable paragraphs commonly used to express a reasoning model’s thinking. Pourya Kordi argues that writing out every step in readable text makes a model’s thinking more brittle. He plays a clip describing the idea of leaving part of a model’s internal reasoning unsupervised during training, so that it stays representative of what the model is doing and researchers can keep understanding capable, long-running systems. A model can also perform reasoning steps within a single pass through a deep network, so internal steps alone do not establish which architecture it uses.

Recurrent depth is one way to give a model more internal computation: it repeatedly runs shared network layers rather than adding separately trained layers. A recurrent-depth language model can do that extra work without generating additional textual reasoning tokens.

Jonas Geiping and eight co-authors introduced a recurrent-depth language model in a paper submitted in 2025 and subsequently published at NeurIPS 2025. Their Huginn-0125 model first converts input tokens into numerical representations. It repeatedly updates those representations through a shared central block, then calculates next-token probabilities using its final layers.

The proof of concept was trained with 3.5 billion parameters and 800 billion tokens. The researchers report better mathematical and coding performance when they give the model more computation at inference, the stage at which it produces an answer.

A long-standing rumor holds that OpenAI uses recurrent depth in its own models. One version describes final layers looping in latent space until the model decides to output. Lower perplexity might help a model make better use of internal computation.

Scaling a model does not necessarily mean adding hardware alone. A tenfold increase in algorithmic efficiency can have an effect equivalent to using ten times as much compute. More efficient algorithms can increase the effective computation available for pre-training, while additional compute and algorithmic gains can both contribute to progress.

An Anthropic chart plots effective compute on a logarithmic axis, showing an exponential rise over time. Raw compute may not keep increasing tenfold every couple of years, although algorithmic efficiency could compensate if hardware scaling plateaus.

AI research is becoming harder, and progress has not kept pace with labs’ spending and hiring. Gains from chain-of-thought could also divert labs from scaling and lowering perplexity, though the focus may now be shifting back toward those approaches.

Improving a smaller network’s perplexity for a fixed compute budget is one possible research task for AI. Lessons from human-led experiments on smaller networks have transferred to larger models, and similar transfer is expected from AI-led work. Whether recursive self-improvement can offset hardware limits and a dwindling supply of easy algorithmic gains remains an open question.

For OpenAI, the internal metric offers a way to track pre-training before a finished model’s capabilities are known. It does not identify the next skill that will appear or establish that a particular architecture caused it. The anticipated 0.68-0.7 range is therefore a checkpoint to watch, not a forecast of a specific capability.

In our view, the key idea is that perplexity is measured on the raw model before post-training. It describes the quality of the material, not what anyone can do with it. Chain-of-thought reasoning can improve capabilities without lowering the base model’s perplexity. A dependable signal that cannot name its outcome is an odd thing to rely on. We would treat the claim that every AI skill flows from one chart as an argument, not a finding. Pourya Kordi calls the 0.7 checkpoint somewhat arbitrary, and calls recurrent depth a long-standing rumor, so weigh both accordingly.

You can put AI spending announcements in perspective by looking for gains achieved without a larger computing budget. For anyone following how AI capabilities develop, it is worth taking a closer look at whether algorithmic improvements on smaller models carry over to larger ones.

Getting an iPhone for reliable everyday photography without paying flagship prices is the main appeal of Apple’s rumoured iPhone 18e, an entry-level handset that Apple has not yet announced or confirmed. According to a video breakdown from Techtics and supply-chain CAD files reviewed by Engadget, the phone could adopt a raised camera plateau measuring roughly 28 by 35 millimeters while still keeping a single rear camera. A larger sensor or thicker module could explain the extra footprint, though nothing is confirmed—and as with any unannounced product, specifications, design details, pricing, and launch timelines remain subject to change.

Camera plateau: Leaked CAD files depict an almost square 28 by 35-millimeter housing that groups the iPhone 18e’s camera, LED flash, and rear microphone together. Single rear lens: Despite the wider housing, the iPhone 18e is expected to stick with one rear camera rather than adding an ultrawide lens. Extra module depth: Reports note the camera bump could measure around 3.8 mm thick (up from 3.45 mm), leaving room for a potential sensor upgrade or internal packaging. Sibling leaks: Separate dummy units point to a standard iPhone 18 resembling the iPhone 17 and an iPhone Air 2 gaining a second rear camera. Fake assembly image: A separate viral factory photo carries an AI watermark and should be treated as unreliable.

Leaked computer-aided design (CAD) drawings suggest the iPhone 18e will consolidate its rear camera lens, LED flash, and rear microphone onto a single raised plateau instead of keeping them separated on the back glass.

On the current entry-level iPhone 17e, a single circular camera lens protrudes modestly from the rear glass while the True Tone flash and rear microphone occupy separate flush cutouts. That 17e setup uses a 48MP Fusion camera with a 26 mm focal length, f/1.6 aperture, sensor-shift optical image stabilization, Hybrid Focus Pixels, and a sapphire crystal lens cover—delivering an optical-quality 12MP 2x Telephoto crop at 52 mm without needing a second physical lens.

According to the leaked CAD measurements, the iPhone 18e swaps that minimal ring for a nearly square raised housing measuring about 28 by 35 millimeters (and roughly 3.8 mm thick) that brings the camera, flash, and microphone into one unified module. Even with that larger footprint, the drawings show only a single camera cutout, pointing to another single-lens setup.

Visually, the squared-off plateau echoes the camera housing seen on Apple’s recent iPad Pro tablets, which group their lens, flash, and LiDAR scanner inside a similar island. On the iPhone 18e, extra space and depth inside the bump could accommodate an updated or larger 48MP image sensor—or aid internal packaging around a larger battery—though Apple has not confirmed any sensor change.

While Apple’s budget-minded “e” tier often borrows design cues from earlier flagships, broader supply-chain leaks highlight how Apple plans to differentiate its upcoming spring 2027 roster. Dummy units circulating alongside the iPhone 18e files depict a standard iPhone 18 closely resembling the iPhone 17 and retaining a dual-camera system, alongside an iPhone Air 2 gaining a second rear lens while keeping its ultra-thin profile.

If those leaks prove accurate, keeping a single camera on the iPhone 18e preserves a clear functional step up for buyers considering the regular iPhone 18—where an ultrawide lens enables macro shots, spatial capture, and wider framing that a single main sensor cannot replicate.

Not every iPhone 18e image making the rounds deserves equal weight. The CAD measurements reviewed by Engadget originated from an Apple supply-chain source with a track record of accurately predicting hardware details such as upcoming iPhone finishes. By contrast, a separate viral photo purporting to show an assembled iPhone 18e on a factory line contains an embedded AI watermark—confirming it was generated or heavily altered with AI tools rather than captured on an assembly floor.

Giving the iPhone 18e an iPad Pro-style camera bump changes its visual identity from the back, yet the practical buying question remains unchanged: how much does the camera inside actually improve over the iPhone 17e? Without an ultrawide lens, the regular iPhone 18 keeps a tangible versatility edge for travel, group shots, and tight indoor scenes.

Ultimately, whether the extra bump dimensions translate into a larger sensor with better low-light detail or simply a unified housing will determine how compelling the iPhone 18e is for everyday photographers. Remember that Apple has not announced the iPhone 18e, iPhone 18, or iPhone Air 2, so all reported designs, specifications, pricing, and launch windows remain unconfirmed and subject to change.

Valve says it has cleared all reservations for the 2 TB Steam Machine but is still working through the separate waitlist. It will continue offering machines to people on that list while it has supply to sell.

Developers are split on how to run coding agents: as a team you manage, or as a factory you define in code. You can also keep a person involved in new features and replay past work to test how a setup performs. A closer look from Ray Amjad shows how coded workflows and leads with flexible blueprints handle implementation, review and verification. You’ll learn how work moves between agents, as well as why shared budgets complicate decisions about which tasks get done first.

Agent teams delegate work through roles, while software factories define repeatable stages, handoffs and checks in code. In the Devin Bots demonstration, a lead can manage five or 10 workers in separate sandboxes and steer their work. In a hybrid approach, an engineering lead gives workers a skill-file blueprint that allows them to adapt their approach during a task. OpenAI reports a 500% increase in landed pull requests on some teams after introducing Symphony. In Ray Amjad’s own blind replay, removing planners made no measurable difference to quality, while mean cost per pull request fell from $940 to about $630.

Agent teams organize coding agents into roles that can delegate work to one another. Software factories can instead define stages, handoffs and checks in code, making the process repeatable across tasks.

You do not necessarily have to choose between the two: an agent framework can operate inside a software factory. The distinction depends partly on how a developer defines a factory.

A team can assign each lead agent a domain, such as documentation, feature development, quality assurance or security. You can talk to a lead directly or route requests through a chief-of-staff agent that coordinates the leads.

In the arrangement demonstrated with Cognition’s Devin Bots, a lead delegates work to worker threads in separate sandboxes, or isolated computing environments. Leads have smaller sandboxes than workers, and you can message worker threads directly. A lead can manage five or 10 workers, exchange messages with them and steer their work; workers report back when they finish.

Leads can persist across projects or exist for a particular job, such as a migration. Both leads and workers can create subagents within their own sandboxes. A worker might use one to review code after implementation or research a missing detail in a separate context window.

Devin Bots provides templates for roles including a software factory, technical writer and chief of staff, as well as products, migration, iOS, Android and compliance engineers and a code reaper. A team can share a lead through Slack, including public channels, control who can use it and choose whether it can message other bots.

Shared bots can have their own identities, and a Slack message returns to the same Devin session. Connections can also give a bot plugins, MCP servers, automations and secrets.

Other tools coordinate coding agents differently. Grok Bot can use leads to spawn subagents that manage a computer or Cursor cloud agents in another sandbox. Steve Yegge’s Gas Town uses a coordinating agent called the Mayor to distribute and track groups of tasks. OpenAI’s Symphony assigns agents to active project-management issues and restarts agents that crash or stall.

Teams carry a cost. Anthropic’s Claude Code agent teams, for example, remain disabled by default and require explicit activation. They consume substantially more tokens than individual sessions because each teammate runs as a separate Claude instance.

Here are more guides from our previous articles and guides related to Devin Bots and MCP integrations that you may find helpful.

A factory-as-code approach defines the process before work starts. A file such as factory.yaml can specify stages, how information passes between them and gates that decide whether work moves on or returns to an earlier stage.

The case for it is that running coding agents is an optimization problem: you want higher quality and more output at a lower cost, and you can only optimize what you can measure. A process fixed in code stays the same between runs, so it can be measured. In the words Ray Amjad quotes, a factory should scale like an engineered system, not like an increasingly large organization.

One coded workflow can send a specification, prompt and output schema to an implementation agent, then fork the agent’s sandbox into parallel jobs for code review and identifying the flows added. Output schemas can act as gates that send work back to a previous sandbox, while further sandboxes verify the flows before a final request.

Factories can also differ in how much human involvement they assume. StrongDM described a development process without human-written code or human code review, while OpenAI uses Symphony to coordinate feature development and infrastructure migrations. OpenAI reports a 500% increase in landed pull requests on some teams after introducing Symphony.

Frameworks can mix fixed operations with agent decisions rather than choosing only one. LangGraph combines predefined software operations with AI-driven decisions, while CrewAI combines collaborating groups of agents with application workflows. Symphony is a reference implementation, not a standalone product OpenAI intends to maintain.

You can measure a coded process against a simpler version by replaying earlier work. Ray Amjad ran a blind test of this kind on his own factory, replaying past pull requests with a layer of planners and subplanners removed.

The test found no measurable change in quality, and mean cost per pull request fell from $940 to about $630. The planners had been intended to make planning parallel and recursive.

A factory lead could also run a weekly automation that edits a workflow blueprint and compares it against an earlier version using past pull requests. Such a comparison could examine worker runtime, compute and token use, though Ray Amjad cautions that tuning the blueprint risks overfitting it.

In a hybrid approach, an engineering lead receives a skill file as a blueprint, then passes it to workers spawned for individual features. Each worker can contain builder, reviewer and verifier roles that loop through the work, while the lead coordinates them and retains the wider context.

That context could let the lead reuse an existing worker when a new task is mostly similar to work already under way, rather than starting an entirely separate task. The skill file gives the agent room to change its approach during a task, unlike the earlier workflow whose stages were coded up front.

A hierarchy requires decisions about who talks to whom, how many layers to add and whether roles overlap. A software factory lead and a feature-builder lead might cover much of the same ground, whereas a technical writer has a distinct responsibility.

Ray Amjad recommends splitting leads by domain rather than workflow step, because handoffs between separate planning, implementation and review leads can lose information. Communication frequency can help determine the split: separate implementer, reviewer and verifier leads would communicate almost daily. In the proposed feature-building arrangement, those implementation, review and verification roles sit inside one lead’s workers instead.

A factory can also act as a single consumer of work from a queue such as GitHub issues, which a factory bot could check hourly. A QA agent might discover a bug and send it to the factory. The QA agent could fix the bug faster itself, but might lack the factory bot’s accumulated memory and be more likely to make a mistake.

Other agents could contribute work to the queue, including customer-support or growth leads. For brand-new features, Ray Amjad recommends keeping a person involved because he finds agents’ product taste is not yet good enough.

When people use separate chief-of-staff agents, those agents may need to coordinate over the same leads and a limited resource. In an Anthropic example, six tasks share an API token budget too small to complete them all: three tasks have high value and three have low value.

With one chief-of-staff agent, the high-value tasks are completed and the low-value tasks canceled. With separate chiefs coordinating peer-to-peer, too much low-value work may be done before the budget runs out, leaving high-value work unfinished. Ray Amjad concludes that a setup with many people and many agents may bring friction that is not worth it yet, though he expects the models to get better at this.

Choosing between a hierarchy and a coded factory therefore also involves how you assign work and how agents share resources. A fixed pipeline puts stages and gates in code; a lead using a skill file can alter its route as work develops. Agent teams can sit inside either approach, but separate leads still need a way to coordinate their work.

In our view, the useful question is not bots versus code but whether you can show that each layer earns its place. Without a way to measure, extra roles and planners are easy to add and hard to justify. We would treat the cost and quality claims as one person’s result on one setup. The reported blind replay found no measurable quality change after removing planners, while mean cost per pull request fell from $940 to about $630. Check against your own past work before cutting roles or copying a hierarchy, since what a team can safely drop depends on its codebase.

Giving each person an agent does not necessarily give your team better control over which work gets done first. If you are organizing coding agents around a shared budget, it is worth looking more closely at how separate leads settle priorities, rather than judging the setup only by the tasks each agent completes.

Anthropic says a Claude model that saved 413 memory files earned one badge in Pokémon Red, while a newer one that kept just 10 earned four. Anthropic’s research on agent memory carries a lesson for Anthropic Claude Code, its AI coding assistant, which keeps notes between sessions. As Simon Scrapes explains, you can keep project instructions focused on information Claude cannot find in your files, rather than duplicating the codebase. See how saved notes, searchable session history and focused instructions serve different purposes when you use Claude Code across long-running projects.

In one run each, Anthropic says Sonnet 3.7 earned one badge with 413 memory files, while Fable 5 earned four with 10. The test compared model generations and Claude models, not memory size alone or Claude Code itself. Anthropic says corrected memory helped Claude reach Cerulean City in 1,935 actions, while uncorrected-memory and memory-free runs failed within 3,000 actions. Claude Code automatically loads only the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md, whichever limit comes first. Conversation transcripts are wiped every 30 days, and /resume requires knowing which old session to resume.

Claude Code, Anthropic’s coding tool, can retain notes between sessions rather than rely only on the current conversation. These notes are persistent agent memory, not computer RAM or the model’s maximum context window.

One caution applies to everything below. Anthropic’s experiment tested Claude models playing a game, not Claude Code writing software, and it compared different generations of model rather than changing memory size on its own. The smaller memory may be a sign of a more capable model as much as a cause of its progress.

Anthropic published its research on November 6, 2026, using Pokémon Red to examine how Claude models identify information worth retaining. As each model played, it could read and write files in a memory directory.

At approximately 10,000 steps, Claude Sonnet 3.7 had earned one badge, while Claude Fable 5 had earned four, according to Anthropic. Their memory stores differed sharply:

The comparison used one run each of Sonnet 3.7 and Fable 5. Sonnet recorded individual encounters, battles and collected items, while Fable prioritized objectives, navigation plans and strategies it had checked. Anthropic says Sonnet also spent 17 consecutive steps creating six files and deleting nine without taking a gameplay action.

An earlier comparison showed a similar difference between model generations. At 14,000 steps, Anthropic says Claude Sonnet 3.5 had 31 memory files and remained in the second town, while Claude Opus 4.6 had 10 files and three gym badges.

Browse through more resources below from our in-depth content covering more areas on Claude Code memory and tools.

A large archive can contain information that no longer matches the task. Claude does not routinely recheck whether its notes remain true, and much of what Anthropic has shipped on memory this autumn is aimed at that problem. In Anthropic’s Pokémon research, Sonnet 3.7’s notes repeatedly became outdated as the game progressed.

Anthropic also ran a separate experiment with Claude Managed Agents to compare corrected memory, uncorrected memory and no memory. A wrong note about Mount Moon sent Claude off the same ledge three times. An offline process called dreaming checked the note against the session transcript and corrected it.

With corrected memory, Claude reached Cerulean City after 1,935 actions, Anthropic says. Neither the uncorrected-memory run nor the memory-free run reached the city within the illustrated 3,000-action evaluation. Simon Scrapes adds that over 128 sessions, the share of answers Claude could get from its notes alone rose from 13% to 48% with dreaming.

Dreaming reads an agent’s memory and up to 100 past sessions, then creates a revised memory that merges duplicates, replaces outdated or contradicted notes and adds new information. It leaves the original untouched, so you can review or discard the changes.

Useful memory depends on finding the right information when you need it, not simply on storing more. Claude’s default recall depends on what it chose to save, and a decision from six months ago may never have entered a memory note. Claude can search conversation transcripts by keyword, but a search may miss an unsaved decision described in different words.

By default, Claude Code deletes transcripts after 30 days, and the /resume command requires you to know which old session to resume. Searching old sessions can use many tokens, while meaning-based search can help when keywords fail to find an older decision.

Other systems take different approaches to retrieval. Hermes injects a capped memory snapshot at the start of each session, while MEM searches by meaning. Garry Tan’s GBrain cites its answers and says when it cannot find information.

Simon Scrapes makes Agentic OS, so the claims reported here about it are the maker’s own. It saves every turn to long-term storage and lets Claude promote what matters into a snapshot capped at 2,000 characters, which loads every session. It searches the long-term store by meaning and by keyword, then cites the file, line and date, or says it found nothing.

Claude Code has global and project CLAUDE.md files, alongside an auto-memory folder under .claude/projects. Claude writes its own MEMORY.md and topic files there, retaining preferences, feedback, project context and references that may matter in later sessions, including information about the user. Each project has its own MEMORY.md, which carries decisions between threads. Auto-memory skips information Claude can work out from files.

Only the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md, whichever limit is reached first, load automatically at the start of a session. Claude must look for notes beyond that limit. It retrieves additional memory files when needed and is instructed to shorten its index as it approaches the line limit. Anthropic’s documentation also says concise, specific instructions improve adherence to them.

You can open /memory to inspect what Claude has chosen to keep. Simon Scrapes recommends keeping CLAUDE.md focused on information Claude cannot find in the project files, rather than duplicating the codebase. For most people, he says, a tidy CLAUDE.md and a weekly dreaming pass may suffice if dreaming becomes available to them.

We would bear in mind that the evidence comes from a single game test and that the video also promotes its own course and memory system. Before changing your setup, check whether your projects actually suffer from missing or stale notes. In our view, the useful lesson is that memory only helps if its contents are correct and easy to find. The Mount Moon note sent Claude off the same ledge three times, showing how an error can persist. A wrong note keeps steering the AI, so a short list you can trust beats a long one.

Less loaded memory need not mean losing your project’s history: a short working snapshot and a searchable archive serve different jobs. You can keep everyday context separate from older decisions that need deeper searching, while dreaming remains a research preview for managed agents. If you use Claude Code across long-running projects, its memory system is worth exploring in more detail to understand what carries between sessions and what needs a separate way to be found.

An RTX 5090 at $6,133 writes more slowly than an RTX 3090 costing less than a quarter as much once a prompt reaches 64,000 tokens. That is one result from a ranking of ten GPU setups for local AI, from used server cards to current desktop cards, compared on cost and writing speed. According to Kai, how quickly a model reads your prompt matters alongside writing speed, especially when you paste in large documents. You’ll learn how memory capacity, software support and prompt length affect your choice, and why a faster card does not always deliver faster responses.

No official Qwen4 weights were downloadable on November 26, so the comparison uses Qwen3.8-27B and does not guarantee Qwen4 performance. One owner measured 34.2 tokens per second on two RTX 3060 12 GB cards, priced at $616 together, with 131,000 tokens of context. Two Tesla P100 cards cost $352 but take nine to 11 minutes to process a 65,000-token prompt. The RTX 3090 averages $1,445 and reaches 41.3 tokens per second on current llama.cpp. Hardware Corner measured RTX 5090 plain-decode speed falling from 74.83 tokens per second at 4,000 tokens of context to 26.22 at 64,000.

Alibaba released Qwen4-Max through its cloud services on November 16, 2026, and checks on November 26 found no official downloadable Qwen4 weights. Alibaba says it will release smaller open-weight Qwen4 models worldwide soon.

The comparisons below use Qwen3.8-27B, an existing downloadable model, rather than the forthcoming weights. Prices were checked on November 25 and generally use GPU Poet’s average of the three cheapest listings. These results do not guarantee future Qwen4 performance.

Decode speed measures how quickly a model writes tokens, while prefill measures how quickly it first reads a prompt. Memory bandwidth helps determine decode speed, while prefill matters when your prompt contains a large document or codebase.

The ranking uses plain decode rather than multi-token prediction (MTP), which can increase speed by guessing and checking tokens together. Qwen3.8-27B runs with MTP, but the llama.cpp MTP contribution for Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-Flash-Next architecture preview remained a draft as of November 25, while vLLM supports it on NVIDIA cards. Plain results are therefore the safer basis for a purchase, not a confirmed Qwen4 benchmark.

Each setup is ranked by dollars per token per second: its price divided by its plain decode speed. A lower figure means more writing speed for the money.

For conversational workloads on a budget, consider this pair. At $616 for both cards, one owner measured 34.2 tokens per second with 131,000 tokens of context and a 4-bit KV cache, or about $18 per token per second.

Together, the cards have 24 GB combined and 360 GB/s bandwidth each. They support 64,000 tokens of full-precision context on the comparison model, with longer context possible using a 4-bit cache. Another owner reported roughly four and a half minutes to process a 129,000-token prompt. Use the 12 GB cards, a motherboard with two PCIe 3 x8 slots, and tensor split rather than layer split.

At $352, the P100 pair is inexpensive, but you face long waits with large prompts. Stock llama.cpp produces 17.5 tokens per second, or $20 per token per second, despite combined memory bandwidth of 1,464 GB/s.

Developer Kmic’s card-specific llama.cpp fork raises plain decode to 32.6 tokens per second, or $11 per token per second, and Kmic has said the fork will be updated for Qwen4. At 65,000 tokens, prefill runs at 101 to 119 tokens per second, taking nine to 11 minutes. vLLM does not support these cards.

The 32 GB Tesla V100 PCIe gives you room for 128,000 tokens of context without a second GPU. At $981, one owner measured 33.3 tokens per second at 4,000 tokens of context, or $29 per token per second.

With 900 GB/s memory bandwidth, the card draws 250 W and has neither fans nor display output. CUDA 13 dropped support for its Volta architecture, and R580 is its last supported driver branch. If future Qwen4 engine releases require CUDA 13, the card would be left out.
